title: Rabbi Simon ben Kozot
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Shir HaShirim Rabbah 8:6, speaking in Rabbi Levi’s name. Hyman cites the statement in Pesikta deRav Kahana 134a, where he reports R’ Simai bar Kosi in the name of R’ Yochai.[^1]

notes.text: The consulted Shir HaShirim Rabbah 8:6:3 has Rabbi Simon ben Kuzit in Rabbi Levi’s name. The corresponding Pesikta deRav Kahana 17:8 in the Mandelbaum edition has R’ Simon be-R’ Koi in R’ Yochanan’s name; Hyman’s folio 134a and the forms Simai bar Kosi/Yochai are retained as his report.
